# Godot 大型项目避坑 知识图谱

## 位置 vs 偏移

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    P["位置 (Position)"] --> RM["真实移动 (Real Movement)"]
    P --> TX["影响纹理位置 (Affects Sprite Texture)"]
    P --> PH["用于游戏逻辑 (Used in Game Logic)"]
    O["偏移 (Offset)"] --> VA["视觉偏移 (Visual Adjustment)"]
    O --> TX2["仅影响纹理 (Only Affects Texture)"]
    O --> NA["不影响碰撞 (No Effect on Collision)"]
    C["碰撞形状 (CollisionShape)"] --> PH2["基于位置计算 (Calculated from Position)"]
    A --> PH2
    PH --> C
```

## 负向缩放 vs Sprite 翻转

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    NS["负向缩放 X 轴 (Negative Scale X)"] --> VT["视觉变换传递给子节点 (Visual Transform)"]
    NS --> PT["物理变换传递给子节点 (Physics Transform)"]
    PT --> AS["Area2D 碰撞形状 (Area2D Collision)"]
    PT --> RC["RayCast 检测 (RayCast)"]
    VT --> SF["视觉上看似正常 (Looks Correct Visually)"]
    PT --> MI["物理交互错位 (Misaligned Physics)"]
    MI --> EH["错误命中 / 失效 (Hit Miss / Failure)"]
    SF --> UF["使用 sprite2D flip_h 处理视觉 (Use sprite2D flip_h)"]
    PT --> SP["为物理创建独立节点 (Separate Physical Node)"]
    SP --> ST["存储两套变换 (Store Two Transforms)"]
```

## 预加载链与内存管理

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    MG["主游戏脚本 (Main Game Script)"] --> PL["预加载 主菜单 (Preload MainMenu)"]
    PL --> PC["预加载 开场动画 (Preload Cutscene)"]
    PC --> PLV["预加载 第一级别 (Preload Level1)"]
    PLV --> PR["持久引用 (Persistent Reference)"]
    PR --> ML["内存泄漏风险 (Memory Leak)"]
    MG --> ST["始终在场景树 (Always in SceneTree)"]
    ST --> NR["不释放已卸载场景 (Never Release Unloaded Scenes)"]
    NR --> ML
